Incline bench press: lying on a bench inclined about 30 degrees, pressing a barbell up from the upper chest, arms nearly locked out
Incline dumbbell press: lying on a bench inclined about 30 degrees, pressing two dumbbells up from the upper chest
Dumbbell bench press: lying on a flat bench, pressing two dumbbells up from the chest
Dips: supported on parallel bars, body leaning slightly forward, elbows bent about 90 degrees at the bottom of a dip
Push-up: in a push-up position on the floor, chest halfway down, body in a straight line
Overhead press: standing, pressing a barbell from the shoulders overhead, arms nearly locked out
Dumbbell shoulder press: seated on an upright bench, pressing two dumbbells overhead from shoulder height
Lateral raise: standing, raising two dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent
Face pull: standing at a cable tower, pulling a rope attachment towards the face, elbows high and flared out
Triceps pushdown: standing at a cable tower, pushing a straight bar down with elbows pinned to the sides, arms almost straight
Skull crusher: lying on a flat bench, lowering a barbell towards the forehead by bending only the elbows
Squat: barbell across the upper back, in a deep squat with thighs just below parallel, chest up
Front squat: barbell racked on the front of the shoulders, elbows high, in a deep upright squat
Leg press: seated in a 45-degree leg press machine, knees bent deeply, feet on the platform
Lunge: stepping forward into a lunge, back knee close to the floor, holding dumbbells at the sides
Bulgarian split squat: rear foot elevated on a bench behind, front leg in a deep split squat, holding dumbbells at the sides
Leg extension: seated in a leg extension machine, straightening the knees against the pad
Deadlift: standing up from the floor with a loaded barbell, halfway up, back flat, bar close to the shins
Romanian deadlift: hips pushed far back, knees slightly bent, lowering a barbell along the thighs to mid-shin, back flat
Leg curl: seated in a leg curl machine, curling the heels down and back against the pad
Hip thrust: upper back on a bench, barbell across the hips, hips fully extended, torso parallel to the floor
Calf raise: standing on the edge of a block, rising high onto the toes, holding a dumbbell
Barbell row: torso bent forward about 45 degrees, rowing a barbell to the lower ribs
Dumbbell row: one knee and hand on a flat bench, rowing a dumbbell to the hip with the other arm
Pull-up: hanging from a bar with an overhand grip wider than the shoulders, chin pulled above the bar
Chin-up: hanging from a bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip, chin pulled above the bar
Lat pulldown: seated at a lat pulldown machine, pulling a wide bar down to the upper chest, thighs under the pads
Seated cable row: seated at a low cable row, feet on the platform, pulling a handle to the stomach, chest up
Shrug: standing, holding heavy dumbbells at the sides, shoulders shrugged up towards the ears
Biceps curl: standing, curling two dumbbells up towards the shoulders, elbows at the sides
Hammer curl: standing, curling two dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs up), elbows at the sides
Preacher curl: seated at a preacher bench, upper arms resting on the angled pad, curling a barbell up
Cable fly: standing between two high cable pulleys, bringing the handles together in front of the chest in a hugging arc
Plank: in a forearm plank on the floor, body in a straight line from head to heels
Hanging leg raise: hanging from a pull-up bar, legs raised straight in front to hip height
Cable crunch: kneeling below a high cable, holding a rope at the head, crunching the torso down towards the knees
Farmer's carry: walking upright while holding a very heavy dumbbell in each hand at the sides
Good morning: barbell on the upper back, hinging forward at the hips with a flat back until the torso is near parallel
Arnold press: seated, pressing two dumbbells overhead while rotating the palms from facing in to facing forward
Cable lateral raise: standing side-on to a low cable pulley, raising the handle out to the side to shoulder height with one arm
Cable Y-raise: standing between two low cable pulleys, raising both handles up and out into a Y shape above the head
Behind-the-back cuffed cable lateral rai: standing side-on to a low cable, the cable running behind the back to a cuff on the far wrist, raising that arm out to the side
Reverse pec deck: seated facing the pad of a pec deck machine, sweeping the handles back with straight arms to open the chest
Reverse cable crossover: standing between two high cable pulleys, crossing arms in front then pulling the cables back and out to the sides
Machine shoulder press: seated in a shoulder press machine, pressing the handles overhead
Standing machine lateral raise: standing in a lateral raise machine, raising the arm pads out to the sides to shoulder height
Lean-in dumbbell lateral raise: holding an upright post with one hand and leaning the body towards it, raising a dumbbell out to the side with the other arm
Side-lying dumbbell lateral raise: lying on the side on an incline bench, raising a dumbbell up from the hip with the top arm
Bent-over reverse dumbbell fly: torso bent forward near parallel, raising two dumbbells out to the sides with slightly bent arms
Seated machine lateral raise: seated in a lateral raise machine, elbows against the pads, raising them out to the sides
Lean-away dumbbell lateral raise: holding an upright post with one hand and leaning the body away from it, raising a dumbbell out to the side with the other arm
Super-ROM dumbbell lateral raise: standing, raising two dumbbells out to the sides all the way above the head, palms facing in
Seated barbell overhead press: seated on an upright bench, pressing a barbell overhead from the front of the shoulders
Upright row: standing, pulling a barbell straight up along the body to chest height, elbows high and out
Hack squat: in a hack squat machine, back against the angled pad, in a deep squat with shoulders under the pads
Pendulum squat: in a pendulum squat machine, shoulders under the pads, sinking into a very deep squat
Smith machine squat: barbell of a Smith machine across the upper back, feet slightly forward, in a deep squat
Low-bar squat: barbell resting low on the rear shoulders, torso leaning forward more, in a squat to parallel
Reverse Nordic: kneeling upright with feet anchored, leaning the straight torso backwards by bending only at the knees
Goblet squat: holding one dumbbell vertically against the chest, in a deep upright squat, elbows inside the knees
Sissy squat: standing on the toes, knees pushed far forward and torso leaning back in a straight line from knees to head
Machine chest press: seated in a chest press machine, pressing the handles forward from chest height
Seated cable pec fly: seated on a bench between two cable pulleys at chest height, bringing the handles together in front of the chest
Deficit push-up: hands on two raised blocks, chest lowered below hand level in a deep push-up
Dumbbell guillotine press: lying on a flat bench, lowering two dumbbells towards the upper chest and neck with elbows flared wide
Smith machine bench press: lying on a flat bench under a Smith machine, pressing the fixed barbell up from the chest
Incline Smith machine bench press: lying on an incline bench under a Smith machine, pressing the fixed barbell up from the upper chest
Cable crossover: standing between two high cable pulleys, one foot forward, pulling the handles down and together in front of the hips
Pec deck: seated in a pec deck machine, bringing the arm pads together in front of the chest
Dumbbell fly: lying on a flat bench, arms spread wide with a slight elbow bend, lowering two dumbbells out to the sides
Cable press-around: standing with the back to one cable pulley, pressing the handle forward and across the body with one arm
Decline bench press: lying on a decline bench, legs hooked at the top, pressing a barbell up from the lower chest
Decline dumbbell press: lying on a decline bench, legs hooked at the top, pressing two dumbbells up from the lower chest
Banded push-up: in a push-up position with a resistance band stretched across the back and held under both hands
Neutral-grip lat pulldown: seated at a lat pulldown machine, pulling a parallel-grip handle down to the upper chest
One-arm lat pulldown: seated at a cable pulldown, pulling a single handle down beside the body with one arm
Cross-body one-arm lat pulldown: half-kneeling beside a high cable, pulling a single handle down and across the body with one arm
Meadows row: staggered stance beside a landmine barbell, rowing the end of the bar with one hand using an overhand grip
Chest-supported row: lying face down on an incline bench, rowing two dumbbells up towards the ribs
Wide-grip cable row: seated at a low cable row, pulling a wide bar to the lower chest with elbows flared out
Neutral-grip pull-up: hanging from parallel handles with palms facing each other, chin pulled above the handles
Deficit Pendlay row: standing on a raised platform, torso parallel to the floor, rowing a barbell explosively from a dead stop to the lower chest
Pendlay row: torso parallel to the floor, rowing a barbell explosively from the floor to the lower chest
Kroc row: one hand braced on a bench, rowing a very heavy dumbbell to the hip with the other arm, torso slightly raised
Cable lat prayer: kneeling in front of a high cable, arms straight, pulling a rope down in an arc to the thighs while hinging forward
Dumbbell pullover: lying across a flat bench, holding one dumbbell with both hands behind the head, arms nearly straight
Overhead cable triceps extension: facing away from a cable, one foot forward, extending the elbows to push a bar from behind the head forward and up
Katana cable triceps extension: standing side-on to a low cable, extending one arm diagonally up and across the body like drawing a sword
One-arm dumbbell overhead extension: seated, holding one dumbbell overhead and lowering it behind the head by bending the elbow
Dumbbell skull crusher: lying on a flat bench, lowering two dumbbells beside the head by bending only the elbows
Smith machine JM press: lying on a flat bench under a Smith machine, lowering the bar towards the upper chest with elbows forward
JM press: lying on a flat bench, lowering a barbell towards the chin with elbows pointing forward, half skull crusher half press
Cable triceps kickback: bent forward at the hips, upper arm pinned to the side, extending the arm back against a low cable
Close-grip bench press: lying on a flat bench, pressing a barbell with hands shoulder-width apart, elbows tucked
Rope triceps pushdown: standing at a cable tower, pushing a rope down and spreading the ends apart at the bottom
Dumbbell French press: seated, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands and lowering it behind the head
Machine dips: seated in a dip machine, pressing the handles down beside the hips
Diamond push-up: in a push-up position with the hands together under the chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond
Bayesian cable curl: facing away from a low cable, one arm stretched behind the body, curling the handle forward
Dumbbell preacher curl: seated at a preacher bench, one upper arm on the angled pad, curling a dumbbell up
Machine preacher curl: seated in a preacher curl machine, upper arms on the pad, curling the handles up
Preacher hammer curl: seated at a preacher bench, curling a dumbbell with a neutral grip (thumb up)
EZ-bar curl: standing, curling an EZ curl bar with an angled grip up towards the shoulders
Incline dumbbell curl: seated back on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down behind the torso, curling two dumbbells
Lying dumbbell curl: lying face up on a high flat bench, arms hanging below the bench, curling two dumbbells
Cable curl: standing at a low cable, curling a straight bar up towards the shoulders
Inverse Zottman curl: standing, curling two dumbbells up with palms facing down, turning palms up at the top
Barbell curl: standing, curling a straight barbell up towards the shoulders, elbows at the sides
Flat bench dumbbell curl: lying face up on a flat bench, arms hanging out to the sides, curling two dumbbells
Walking lunge: mid-stride in a walking lunge, back knee close to the floor, holding dumbbells at the sides
Machine hip abduction: seated in a hip abduction machine, pushing the knees outwards against the pads
45-degree back extension: on a 45-degree back extension bench, hips on the pad, torso raised in line with the legs
Front-foot-elevated Smith machine lunge: under a Smith machine bar, front foot on a low step, in a deep split lunge
Smith machine lunge: under a Smith machine bar, in a deep split lunge, back knee close to the floor
Machine hip thrust: seated back in a hip thrust machine, pad across the hips, hips fully extended
Single-leg dumbbell hip thrust: upper back on a bench, one foot on the floor and the other leg raised, a dumbbell on the hip, hips extended
Cable glute kickback: bent slightly forward holding a cable tower, kicking one leg straight back against an ankle cuff
Step-up: stepping up onto a box with one foot, holding dumbbells at the sides
Glute bridge: lying on the back on the floor, knees bent, barbell across the hips, hips raised
Cable hip abduction: standing side-on to a low cable, an ankle cuff on the far leg, raising that leg out to the side
Curtsy lunge: stepping one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy lunge, holding dumbbells
Sumo deadlift: very wide stance, toes out, hands inside the knees, lifting a barbell from the floor with an upright torso
Cable pull-through: facing away from a low cable, rope between the legs, hips pushed back in a hinge, about to stand up
